title: thefuck rule: php_s

spec.text: New rule: when someone runs php with -s (lowercase) meaning the built-in web server flag -S, suggest the same command with -S.

context: thefuck rules: match() decides whether the rule applies; get_new_command() builds the corrected command. @for_app('php') only calls match() for commands whose program is php. requires_output = False lets the rule run without capturing the command's output.

source.notes: Code at buggy commit 64d6835; key from fix commit 75d2c43, whose message says: 'Unfortunately, I didn't catch these issues while reviewing #702.'
